loop.top3_why: The trimmed‑mean over the larger pool (pool3) gives the lowest overall validation score and shows the most stable performance across the three windows (0.3567, 0.6550, 0.5311). It includes the most consistently ranked models and is robust to the high error correlation indicated in the diagnostics. The slight edge in the first window and acceptable performance in the others suggest it will generalize better than the mean or a smaller trimmed‑mean pool.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (mean pool3) has a higher overall score and worse performance in the third window, indicating it is more sensitive to outliers. Candidate C (trimmed‑mean pool2) uses fewer models, which may reduce robustness when the ranking stability is only moderate and the error correlation is high. Both alternatives are therefore less likely to generalize as well as the larger trimmed‑mean pool in A.
